appearance_facts.fact: The chart is titled 'District Heating Demand Index'.
The y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 24.0°C, with major gridlines at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20).
The x-axis shows years from 2005 to 2015, with tick marks for each year.
The data is represented by a blue line connecting black circular data points.
Each data point is annotated with its corresponding 'Demand index' value in °C.

public_definitions: The goal is to review the district heat demand dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
The chart reference is to use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period district heat demand change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
The primary field label is 'District heat demand change route'.

The option labels are: 'Route the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change to substantial-change follow-up', 'Keep the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation', 'Route the district heat demand record to archive and background filing'.
The routing criterion is 'Whether the full-period district heat demand change requires substantial-change follow-up'.
